noConnection: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.userExists: There's already an account with that email.
auth.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
auth.samePassword: Your new password has to be different from the current one.
auth.userNotFound: We couldn't find an account with that email.
auth.otpExpired: That code isn't valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.otpDisabled: We can't send codes right now. Try again later.

db.tagNameTaken: You already have a tag with that name.
db.categorySlugTaken: There's already a category with that identifier.
db.accountHasTransactions: You can't delete this account because it has transactions. Archive it instead.
db.related: This can't be done because other data depends on it.
db.peerNoReceiveAccount: {{who}} has no {{currency}} account to receive into. Ask them to pick one in Settings › People.
db.peerInviteInvalid: That code isn't valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
db.peerInviteOwn: That's your own code — share it with the other person so they can use it.
db.peerAlreadyLinked: You're already linked with that person.
db.peerNotLinked: You're no longer linked with that person.
db.peerTransferLocked: This transfer was recorded by the person who sent it: only they can change or delete it.
db.peerArrivesOnItsOwn: Money from a linked person shows up on its own; it can't be recorded by hand.
db.archiveNonZeroBalance: You can't archive an account with a balance. Adjust it to 0 first.
db.categoryTypeWithChildren: You can't change the type of a category that has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
db.currencyInUse: You can't turn off that currency: you still have accounts, budgets or goals in it.
db.systemCategory: This is a system category and can't be deleted.
db.categoryNotArchived: Archive the category first to delete it.
db.categoryHasTransactions: It has transactions — it can't be deleted while it keeps them.
db.categoryInFavorite: It's used by a favorite — remove it from there first.
db.categoryInBudget: It's assigned to a budget — remove it from there first.
db.categoryWrongType: That category doesn't work for this kind of transaction. Pick another one.
db.accountLockedFields: The currency and starting balance can't be changed after the account is created.
db.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
